Salt spray catches the mineral light; wet stone, wind-tossed hair, and precise hand contact ground the scene as physically photographed working technology. Use a medium-wide three-quarter frame that keeps her face, both hands, the gear train, and opened sea aperture readable. Fitted ring joints, carved channels, and raised measurement marks stay sharp. A 40 mm lens at deep focus layers her, the mechanism, and the sea. Blue-hour skylight and quartz glow share reflections across skin, flax, shale, and wet basalt as the breaking wave throws spray through the aperture.
